about: Wireway corridors (Dan 2026-11-11 09:30 and 12:19, DECISIONS B8 'Wireway corridors'): main trunks stay inside these bands so harnesses keep their runs relative to each other. Each corridor is a centre polyline with a full band width; a 'widen' band is part of its corridor. This file is the one source.
status: APPROVED (Dan 2026-11-11 12:19, "Corridor approved."; with Y5 a, Y6 a, Y7 a, Y8 a and Z1 a, DECISIONS B8 "Wireway corridors"): main trunks of every harness stay inside these bands; short branches out to devices may leave them (Y7 a). Checked by check_corridors.py (tools/check_all.py).

frames.car_mm: Cabin editors' frame: x fore-aft in mm (front +), y side to side in mm (LH / driver -, RH +); body manual DI-7 under-body plan, rect [-3455.6, -809.1, 4262.1, 1664.1].
frames.ewd_pt: Engine-bay editors' frame: 1993 EWD p.36 points; x grows toward the LH side, y grows toward the front.
frames.conversion: car_x = 5.3 * y_pt - 1019.1; car_y = 1519.3 - 5.3 * x_pt (5.3 mm per point, pinned on Dan's LH pass-through side to side and RH fender exit fore and aft, X7 a / #640). The EWD view is a perspective drawing, so engine-bay points are about 300 mm out fore and aft at the firewall.

corridors.name: Under the dashboard
corridors.follows: Cowl wire behind the instrument panel, kick panel to kick panel (1993 EWD p.42 and p.44; J/B No.1, J/B No.3, IG1 / IG2 under the ECU); widened back to the wheel speed conditioners in the centre console and forward to the firewall band (Dan Y6 a, 2026-11-11), so the approved wheel speed routes stay as they are

corridors.name: LH kick panel
corridors.follows: J/B No.1, plugs IC1 / IE1 / IF1 and ground ID at the left kick panel (1993 EWD p.42, p.234)

corridors.name: RH kick panel
corridors.follows: R/B No.4 with ground IG on its set bolt, plug IK1 at the right kick panel (1993 EWD p.44, p.234)

corridors.name: Centre console
corridors.follows: Console box wire on the floor tunnel, II1 at the instrument panel centre (1993 EWD p.44, p.234; body manual DI-7 under-body plan, floor tunnel)

corridors.name: Under the front edge of the rear seat
corridors.follows: Rear floor crossmember No.1 under the front edge of the rear seat (body manual DI-7 under-body plan)

corridors.name: LH floor / sill run
corridors.follows: Factory floor wire: IF1 at the left kick panel, BL1 at the left side of the front floor panel, BP1 at the left quarter panel centre (1993 EWD p.234, p.46); the factory rear wheel speed wires join it at IF1 (1992 EWD p.44, p.192-193; Dan Y2 a)

corridors.name: RH sill run
corridors.follows: RH rocker / sill on the body manual DI-7 under-body plan; no factory harness there; kept by Dan Y5 a (2026-11-11): AB-cabin's and RearFuel's sill runs to the trunk battery corner share it, HeavyDC's battery cables too

corridors.name: Inside perimeter of the trunk
corridors.follows: Luggage room wire BP1 at the left quarter panel centre, ground BL at the back panel centre (1993 EWD p.234, p.46); body manual luggage compartment. Back line at x -3135 (Dan Z5 a, 2026-11-11): the band lies fully inside the back wall (DI-7 under-body plan, about x -3211 at the centre, -3203 to -3231 across the car); was -3300, outside the car

corridors.name: LH fender pass-through
corridors.follows: Cowl wire through the LH kick into the engine bay at IE1, up the quarter panel (1993 EWD p.36, p.42; Dan Q2, his 2026-11-01 point)

corridors.name: RH fender exit
corridors.follows: Cowl wire / engine room main wire join EA1 at the RH front fender (1993 EWD p.36, p.234; Dan's 2026-11-01 point)

corridors.name: Inner perimeter of the engine bay
corridors.follows: Cowl wire along the firewall, engine room main wire and engine room No.2 wire along the RH and LH aprons and the radiator support (1993 EWD p.36)

widen.why: RH apron band widened inboard to take Dan's AB-engine passenger front run (Dan Y8 a, 2026-11-11): this band follows his W4 c line 4 (Route 16) from the engine harness trunk start to the oil temp leg; harness C joins the trunk start along it

RH rear corner of the engine bay (Dan Z1 a, 2026-11-11): the factory path from the RH fender exit run straight across to the engine harness trunk start; harness C joins the trunk start along it (no V, no double-back)

corridors.name: Outer perimeter of the engine block (never across it)
corridors.follows: Engine wire around the 3S-GTE block: belt end, intake / firewall side, transaxle end; nothing across the head or the exhaust side (1993 EWD p.36, EB1 / EB2 and splice E5; Dan's 2026-11-10 AB-engine trunk, belt-end drop and turbo branch)

corridors.name: Inside the front bumper
corridors.follows: Engine room main wire out to the front lamps and the outside air temp sensor, low in the front bumper (1993 EWD p.36; U4 a)
